name: ci-release-approved
command: test "$(gh run view 38812142701 -R karttikjangid/homework-tracker-capstone --json conclusion --jq .conclusion)" = success && gh run view 38812142701 -R karttikjangid/homework-tracker-capstone

name: cloud-helm-upgrade
command: helm upgrade homework ./helm/taskboard -n session21 --set ingress.className=traefik --set ingress.host='' --wait --timeout 240s

name: cloud-updated-images
command: kubectl -n session21 get deployments -o custom-columns='NAME:.metadata.name,IMAGE:.spec.template.spec.containers[*].image,READY:.status.readyReplicas' && kubectl -n session21 get pods,svc,ingress,hpa,pvc

name: cloud-api-after
command: curl -fsS -i http://20.204.56.74/health && curl -fsS http://20.204.56.74/api/tasks && kubectl -n session21 exec deployment/homework-frontend -- wget -T 5 -qO- http://backend:8000/ready && kubectl -n session21 exec deployment/postgres -- psql -U taskboard -d taskboard -c "SELECT title,session_number,due_date,status FROM tasks; SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version;"
